### Setup
```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(limma)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(patchwork)
  library(sva)
  library(matrixStats)
  library(umap)
  library(rprojroot)
  library(ggsci)
})

# Define directories
root_dir     <- find_root(has_dir(".git"))
data_dir     <- file.path(root_dir, "data")
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "human-mirna-expression")
results_dir  <- file.path(analysis_dir, "results")
plot_dir     <- file.path(analysis_dir, "plots")

# Source custom theme
source(file.path(root_dir, "figures", "theme.R"))

# File path for counts
mirna_cts_file <- file.path(results_dir, "merged-miRNA-expression.tsv")

# File path for histology
histology_file <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "histology-preprocessing", "results", "histologies.tsv")
```

### Data Wrangling
```{r data-wrangle}
# Load and filter miRNA counts
mirna_cts <- read_tsv(mirna_cts_file) %>%
  column_to_rownames("miRNA") %>%
  filter(rowSums(across(everything(), ~ . != 0)) >= 2)
```

```{r rename-sample}
names(mirna_cts)[1] <- "4-1958-CC1"
names(mirna_cts)[2] <- "2-1578-CC1"
names(mirna_cts)[3] <- "5-1234-left-pons"
names(mirna_cts)[4] <- "1-1855-CC1"
names(mirna_cts)[5] <- "3-1890-CC1"
```

```{r remove-tumor-infiltrated-sample}
# Remove 5-1234-left-pons showing significant tumor infiltration
mirna_cts <- mirna_cts[, !(colnames(mirna_cts) == "5-1234-left-pons")]
```

```{r fix-tumor-normal-swap}
# Get current column names
current_colnames <- colnames(mirna_cts)

# Find the indices of the two samples
idx_T <- which(current_colnames == "2058-T")
idx_N <- which(current_colnames == "2058-N")

colnames(mirna_cts)[c(idx_T, idx_N)] <- colnames(mirna_cts)[c(idx_N, idx_T)]
```

```{r load-histology}
# Load and annotate histology file
histology_df <- read_delim(histology_file) %>%
  filter(experimental_strategy == "miRNA-Seq") %>%
  filter(external_sample_id %in% names(mirna_cts)) %>%
  arrange(match(external_sample_id, names(mirna_cts))) %>%
  # Fill in any missing histology with "Normal"
  mutate(histology = if_else(is.na(histology), "Normal", histology)) %>%
  mutate(
    batch             = if_else(row_number() <= 4, "batch1", "batch2"),
    condition         = case_when(
      sample_type %in% c("Tumor", "Normal") ~ histology,
      sample_type == "Normal-Tumor Adjacent" ~ paste0(histology, "-adjacent Normal"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    histology_condition = case_when(
      sample_type %in% c("Tumor", "Normal") ~ histology,
      sample_type == "Normal-Tumor Adjacent" ~ "Normal-Tumor Adjacent",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

### PCA: Uncorrected vs Batch-Corrected
```{r get-vsd}
# DESeq2 dataset and VST
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = mirna_cts,
                              colData   = histology_df,
                              design    = ~ batch + histology_condition)
vsd <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds, blind = FALSE)
```

```{r uncorrected-pca}
# Uncorrected PCA
p_uncorr <- plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = c("batch", "histology_condition"), returnData = TRUE)
var_unc  <- round(100 * attr(p_uncorr, "percentVar"))
P1 <- ggplot(p_uncorr, aes(PC1, PC2, color=histology_condition, shape=batch)) +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  scale_color_jco(name = "Condition") +
  labs(title = "PCA (Uncorrected)",
       x = paste0("PC1: ", var_unc[1], "%"),
       y = paste0("PC2: ", var_unc[2], "%")) +
  theme_Publication()
print(P1)
```

```{r batch-corrected-pca}
# Batch-corrected PCA
corrected_counts <- removeBatchEffect(assay(vsd), batch = histology_df$batch)

# PCA
pca_corrected <- prcomp(t(corrected_counts))

# Compute per-miRNA variance
miRNA_vars <- rowVars(corrected_counts)

# Pick the 500 miRNAs with highest variance
top500 <- order(miRNA_vars, decreasing = TRUE)[1:500]

# Subset the matrix to top 500 miRNAs
mat_top500 <- corrected_counts[top500, ]

# Run PCA on the transposed subset
pca_corrected <- prcomp(t(mat_top500), center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)

pc_df    <- as.data.frame(pca_corrected$x) %>%
  mutate(histology_condition = histology_df$histology_condition,
         batch     = histology_df$batch)

percentVar_corrected <- round(100 * (pca_corrected$sdev^2 / sum(pca_corrected$sdev^2)))

P2 <- ggplot(pc_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color=histology_condition, shape=batch)) +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  scale_color_jco(name = "Condition") +
  labs(title = "PCA (Batch Corrected)",
       x=paste0("PC1: ", percentVar_corrected[1], "%"),
       y=paste0("PC2: ", percentVar_corrected[2], "%")) +
  theme_Publication()

print(P2)
```

### Run more stringent filtering of miRNA counts
```{r filtering-mirna-counts}
# Run more stringent filtering of miRNA counts, retaining only those with non-zero counts in >50 samples
mirna_cts_n50 <- mirna_cts %>%
  filter(rowSums(across(everything(), ~ . != 0)) > 50)
```

```{r create-dds-filtered}
dds_filtered <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = mirna_cts_n50, 
                              colData = histology_df, 
                              design = ~ batch + histology_condition)
```

```{r vst-transform-2}
vsdata_filtered <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds_filtered, blind = FALSE)
```

```{r uncorrected-pca-filtered}
p_uncorr_filtered <- plotPCA(vsdata_filtered, intgroup = c("batch", "histology_condition"), returnData = TRUE)
var_unc_filtered  <- round(100 * attr(p_uncorr, "percentVar"))
p_uncorr_filtered$external_sample_id <- rownames(p_uncorr_filtered)

P3 <- ggplot(p_uncorr_filtered, aes(PC1, PC2, color = histology_condition, shape = batch)) +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  scale_color_jco(name = "Condition") +
  labs(title = "PCA (Uncorrected)",
       x = paste0("PC1: ", var_unc_filtered[1], "%"),
       y = paste0("PC2: ", var_unc_filtered[2], "%")) +
  theme_Publication()
print(P3)
```

```{r remove-outlier}
outlier <- "1886-N"

# Subset counts and metadata to exclude outlier
mirna_cts_n50_rm_outlier   <- mirna_cts_n50[, setdiff(colnames(mirna_cts_n50), outlier)]
histology_df_filt <- histology_df   %>% filter(external_sample_id != outlier)

# sanity check
stopifnot(identical(colnames(mirna_cts_n50_rm_outlier), histology_df_filt$external_sample_id))

# Re-create DESeqDataSet and VST
dds_filt <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = mirna_cts_n50_rm_outlier,
  colData   = histology_df_filt,
  design    = ~ batch + condition
)
vsd_filt <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds_filt, blind = FALSE)

# Run PCA as before on vsd_filt
pca_uncorr_filt <- plotPCA(vsd_filt, intgroup = c("batch","histology_condition"), returnData = TRUE)
percentVar_filt <- round(100 * attr(pca_uncorr_filt, "percentVar"))
P4 <- ggplot(pca_uncorr_filt, aes(PC1, PC2, color = histology_condition, shape = batch)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_jco(name = "Condition") +
  labs(title = "PCA (Uncorrected, outlier removed)",
       x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar_filt[1], "%"),
       y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar_filt[2], "%")) +
  theme_Publication()
print(P4)
```

### Save PCA plots
```{r save-pca-plots}
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "mirna-pca-uncorrected.pdf"), plot = P1, width = 10, height = 6)
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "mirna-pca-corrected.pdf"), plot = P2, width = 10, height = 6)
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "mirna-pca-uncorrected-filtered.pdf"), plot = P3, width = 10, height = 6)

```

### PCA: Tumor-Only Analyses
```{r pca-tumor-only-uncorrected}
# Subset tumor samples
tum_df  <- histology_df %>% filter(sample_type == "Tumor")
tum_cts <- mirna_cts[, tum_df$external_sample_id]

# Uncorrected tumor PCA
dds_tum <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(tum_cts, colData = tum_df, design = ~ histology)
vsd_tum <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds_tum, blind = FALSE)
pca_tum <- plotPCA(vsd_tum, intgroup = c("histology","batch"), returnData = TRUE)
var_tum <- round(100 * attr(pca_tum, "percentVar"))
P5 <- ggplot(pca_tum, aes(PC1, PC2, color=histology, shape=batch)) +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  scale_color_jco(name = "Condition") +
  labs(title = "PCA: Tumor Only (Uncorrected)",
       x=paste0("PC1: ", var_tum[1], "%"),
       y=paste0("PC2: ", var_tum[2], "%")) +
  theme_Publication()
print(P5)
```

```{r pca-tumor-only-batch-corrected}
# Batch-corrected tumor PCA (top 500 miRNAs)
v_vars   <- rowVars(removeBatchEffect(assay(vsd_tum), batch = tum_df$batch))
top500   <- order(v_vars, decreasing=TRUE)[1:500]
pc_top   <- prcomp(t(assay(vsd_tum)[top500, ]))
pc_df2   <- as.data.frame(pc_top$x) %>%
  mutate(histology = tum_df$histology, batch = tum_df$batch)
var2     <- round(100 * (pc_top$sdev^2 / sum(pc_top$sdev^2)))
P6 <- ggplot(pc_df2, aes(PC1, PC2, color=histology, shape=batch)) +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  scale_color_jco(name = "Condition") +
  labs(title = "PCA: Tumor Only (Batch Corrected)",
       x=paste0("PC1: ", var2[1], "%"),
       y=paste0("PC2: ", var2[2], "%")) +
  theme_Publication()
print(P6)
```

### Save PCA plots
```{r save-pca-tumor-only-plots}
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "mirna-pca-tumor-only-uncorrected.pdf"), plot = P5, width = 10, height = 6)
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "mirna-pca-tumor-only-corrected.pdf"), plot = P6, width = 10, height = 6)
```

### PCA by Tumor Type vs Controls
```{r pca-each-tumor-vs-controls, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
tumor_types <- c("ATRT", "DIPG or DMG", "EPN", "HGG", "LGG", "MB", "GNT")
controls    <- c("B1", "B2", "B3", "B4", "B5")

for (tumor in tumor_types) {
  tumor_samples    <- histology_df %>% filter(histology == tumor & sample_type == "Tumor")
  adjacent_normals <- histology_df %>% filter(sample_type == "Normal-Tumor Adjacent" & histology == tumor)
  healthy_normals  <- histology_df %>% filter(external_sample_id %in% controls)

  subset_metadata <- bind_rows(tumor_samples, adjacent_normals, healthy_normals)
  subset_cts      <- mirna_cts_n50[, subset_metadata$external_sample_id]

  dds_subset <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = subset_cts,
    colData   = subset_metadata,
    design    = ~ sample_type
  )
  vsd_subset <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds_subset, blind = FALSE)

  pca_data    <- plotPCA(vsd_subset, intgroup = "sample_type", returnData = TRUE)
  percentVar  <- round(100 * attr(pca_data, "percentVar"))
  pca_data$external_sample_id <- rownames(pca_data)

  p <- ggplot(pca_data, aes(PC1, PC2, color = sample_type)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    scale_color_jco(name = "sample_type") +
    labs(
      title = paste("PCA -", tumor, "vs Controls"),
      x     = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance"),
      y     = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance")
    ) +
    theme_Publication()
  
  print(p)

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("mirna-pca-", tumor, "-vs-controls.pdf")),
    plot     = p,
    width    = 10,
    height   = 6
  )
}
```

### UMAP Analyses
```{r umap, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Select top 500 most variable miRNAs
miRNA_vars <- rowVars(assay(vsd))
top500     <- order(miRNA_vars, decreasing = TRUE)[1:500]
umap_input <- t(assay(vsd)[top500, ])

# Configure and run UMAP
set.seed(42)
umap_cfg <- umap.defaults
umap_cfg$n_neighbors <- 15
umap_cfg$min_dist    <- 0.3

umap_res <- umap(umap_input, config = umap_cfg)
umap_df  <- as_tibble(umap_res$layout) %>%
  set_names(c("UMAP1","UMAP2")) %>%
  mutate(external_sample_id = rownames(umap_res$layout)) %>%
  left_join(histology_df, by = "external_sample_id")

# Plot: condition
p_umap1 <- ggplot(umap_df, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = histology_condition, shape = batch)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_jco(name = "Condition") +
  labs(title = "UMAP: Condition",
       x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2") +
  theme_Publication()
print(p_umap1)

# Plot: sample type
p_umap2 <- ggplot(umap_df, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = sample_type, shape = batch)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_jco(name = "Sample Type") +
  labs(title = "UMAP: Sample Type",
       x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2") +
  theme_Publication()
print(p_umap2)
```

### Save UMAP plots

```{r save-umap-plots}
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "mirna-umap-condition.pdf"), plot = p_umap1, width = 10, height = 6)
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "mirna-umap-sample-type.pdf"), plot = p_umap2, width = 10, height = 6)
```
